name: triangulation-public-archive
description: Browse older Triangulation episodes without API credentials
when: Load the first and next archive pages
then: Episode 1 appears first, the next page contains later episodes, and the episode page exposes audio

name: episode-archive-pagination
description: Browse a large episode archive using the TWiT API
given: This Week in Tech selected with API credentials
when: Load the first page and request the next page
then: Both pages contain distinct episodes and API requests respect the rate limiter

name: show-list-display-selection
description: Show aligned date and status metadata while keeping show selection stable
given: A show list with mixed name lengths, known and unknown dates, and active/ended/unknown status
when: Render the list in the Textual selection widget, select a show, then update its date metadata
then: Names remain alphabetically ordered, metadata columns align, and the same show remains selected after its label changes
